theorem lg_target {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E} [ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian μ] [CompleteSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] (h : ∀ (x : E), μ ≠ MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac x) : MeasureTheory.NullSingletonClass μ := by
  have h_density : ∃ (f : E → ℝ) (hf : MeasureTheory.AEStrictlyPositive f μ), MeasureTheory.hasDensity μ f hf := ProbabilityTheory.isGaussian_has_density μ
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h_density
  have h_f : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x
    contrapose! h
    rw [MeasureTheory.ae_eq_iff]
    exact (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_dirac μ h).ae_ne_zero
  have h_ae_eq := MeasureTheory.has_density_ae f hf
  have h_null_singleton : MeasureTheory.NullSingletonClass μ := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.NullSingletonClass.def]
    intro x
    intro h_x
    have := h_ae_eq
    exact h_x
  exact h_null_singleton
